explanation: h(n) (cofactorThreshold) is the largest m such that every n-element A ⊆ ℕ has at least m distinct values a/(a,b), as on erdosproblems.com/539. Allowing 0 ∈ A changes counts by O(1) at most, which is irrelevant here. Erdős [Er73] suggested determining lim log h(n)/log n. The page's h(n) = n^{1/2+o(1)} (Erdős–Szemerédi lower bound plus ProofCouncil upper bound) gives the limit 1/2. The statement asserts convergence to 1/2. Faithful.
